summary: Iteration 2 testing of Family World Cup 2026 (post xlsx auto-import). 29/29 backend pytest pass (18 regression + 11 new iter2 tests for teams=48 / matches=104 / standings / group_rankings uniqueness / v1-deadline late flag / DQ-reinstate / audit log / import-preview / W-placeholder progression). Frontend smoke fully green: login, dashboard shows Swedish team names (Mexiko, Sydafrika, Tjeckien) + TV channels (TV4/SVT) + group standings, Matches page shows match numbers/TV/round/knockout placeholders, Tournament Prediction renders 12 group boxes with rank-{A-L}-{1-4} dropdowns and uniqueness enforcement confirmed (picking team in pos 1 disables it in pos 2), Admin shows all 8 tabs (results/teams/import/deadline/users/invites/scoring/audit) with 104 score input rows, 48 teams listed with DQ/reason controls per team, import file/preview/commit buttons, deadline-input + deadline-save, and audit-log populated.

issues: List of 104 matches is long with no pagination; the All/Group/Knockout/With-Result/No-Result filters help, but consider sticky filter bar or virtualization for performance.

action_items: (Optional polish) Admin Teams tab takes ~2-3s to populate because /api/teams returns 48 docs after tab click; consider a small loading skeleton.
(Optional code quality) progress_tournament() has duplicate placeholder-handling logic for home_placeholder and away_placeholder branches; could be DRY-extracted into a helper to avoid drift.
(Optional) import-commit endpoint returns 200 with {ok:false, errors:[...]} on parse errors instead of 4xx; consider 422 for clearer client signaling.
(Optional) /api/matches GET ignores limit param and always to_list(2000); fine today but document the cap.
critical_code_review_comments: progress_tournament() correctly only resolves group placeholders when group_complete (all teams played 3) and W/RU placeholders only when source match finished — verified by test_09.

tournament-predictions duplicate rejection in same group works (test_04). However, the endpoint does NOT validate that team IDs actually belong to the named group, allowing cross-group team IDs in a ranking. Low risk since frontend dropdowns filter by group, but could add server-side validation.
score_match exact score check uses additive points (3 winner + 2 GD + 5 exact = 10 max) — correct per spec.
/api/config/v1-deadline GET is publicly readable (no auth) — matches expectation since deadline is informational; POST is admin-only via dependency. OK.
seed_from_xlsx_if_needed only re-imports when <48 teams or <100 matched matches; safe idempotent behavior on restart.
server.py is 1070 lines — exceeds 700-line guideline; recommend splitting into routers/auth.py, routers/matches.py, routers/admin.py, services/scoring.py, services/progression.py.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on iter2 critical flows (login, dashboard real data, tournament 12-group uniqueness, matches placeholders/TV, admin 8 tabs, 104 result rows, 48 DQ rows, deadline+import controls, audit log)

seed_data_creation: Tests create a transient invited user (cleaned up), set v1 deadline to past then future (left at +365 days), and temporarily DQ team[0] then reinstate (left reinstated). Match #73 result and forced home/away cleared at end of test_09. No persistent test pollution.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v (~15s, 29 tests). New iter2 suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration2.py and reads REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from env or falls back to /app/frontend/.env. Frontend data-testids cover all iter2 admin tabs: admin-tab-{results|teams|import|deadline|users|invites|scoring|audit}, res-h-/res-a-/res-save-/res-clear-{match_id}, dq-/dq-reason-/reinstate-{team_id}, rank-{A-L}-{1-4}, deadline-input/deadline-save, import-file/import-preview-btn/import-commit-btn. No bugs to fix; iteration 2 is feature-complete and shipping-ready.
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects discovered during iteration 2 testing. Earlier transient 502 on backend_test::test_prediction_locked_after_kickoff was a Cloudflare gateway hiccup that did not reproduce on rerun (full suite passed).
